caption: The drawing depicts a textile or fabric swatch placed over a plain background. The main textile features a repeating geometric and floral pattern composed of circular motifs. Each circle contains a stylized red flower with eight petals, and four green leaves or shapes that are separated but positioned around the flower. Blue lattice-like lines and shapes fill the areas between the circles, forming a connected network across the textile. The background color of the textile is a light cream or off-white. The textile has a decorative fringe on the left and lower edges, with alternating bundles of red, blue, and green threads, and a red border line running parallel to the textile's edge. The composition is rectangular, with the top and right edges squared off, and the bottom and left edges showing the decorative fringe that extends outward. The textile is slightly folded over on the left side, adding depth to the drawing.
title: Coverlet
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
